title: Carbon nanostructure formation over Ni, Co, Fe on γ-Al2O3 during low-temperature dry reforming of methane: insights into mechanisms and catalytic behaviour
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19826-19841
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09618A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Artem Kaporov, Oleksandr Shtyka, Waldemar Maniukiweicz, Jacek Balcerzak, Hanna Kierzkowska-Pawlak, Marcin Kozanecki, Yulia Steksova, Tomasz Maniecki
Reducibility of Ni, Co, and Fe on γ-Al2O3 governs both DRM activity and nanostructured carbon growth: Ni yields filamentous carbon via tip-growth, Co forms graphitic deposits via surface diffusion, and Fe remains catalytically inactive.
